reason: Three real x4plus product runs on original/project-owned text and fine lines, natural landscape texture and a non-square illustration produced exact 4x RGB PNGs. Lettering stayed legible, lines remained continuous, color and orientation were preserved and all outputs were free of model-default anime behavior or whole-image corruption.

samples.observation: English lettering remains readable, the smallest line is continuous and one-pixel rules do not acquire visible breaks or halos.
Mountain, forest and water detail is sharpened with preserved sunrise palette and reflection geometry; no horizontal strip or swapped channel is visible.
Portrait aspect ratio and window, plant and staircase geometry are preserved; texture enhanced without anime-model line replacement.

knownLimitations: Real-ESRGAN can invent plausible micro-texture and thin-edge detail even when the source contains little detail.
This quality decision applies only to the pinned x4plus ncnn snapshot and the recorded inputs.
